sets.name: Current version
sets.about: The version that is live. Written by Microsoft MAI, Zhipu GLM-5, Amazon Nova Pro and xAI Grok from a category list only, and run once after the code was frozen, against pass marks written down beforehand. A scam counts as stopped only if it was not allowed at first AND still not allowed after the buyer answered "how did you check?" truthfully. "Normal, not checked" rows are real bills where the buyer admits they have not checked: the right result is that they stay locked.

sets.name: Declared limit: a buyer who lies
sets.about: Second Look takes the buyer's word about their own check. Here every quiet scam that reached the buyer in rounds two and three is run again with the buyer FALSELY claiming an independent check. Almost all are cleared. Second Look protects a buyer who is being fooled and answers honestly. It does not catch a buyer who has been coached to lie: the check box warns them, and the real fix is payee history on the payment provider's side.

sets.name: Round two (development)
